title: Almost Empty Monochromatic Polygons in Planar Point Sets
summary: For integers $r \ge 3$, $c \ge 2$, and $s \ge 0$, let $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,s)$ denote the smallest integer such that any set of at least $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,s)$ points in the plane in general position (no three on a line), colored with $c$ colors, contains a monochromatic $r$-gon (not necessarily convex) with at most $s$ interior points. Define $λ_r^{\star}(c)$ to be the smallest integer such that $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,λ_r^{\star}(c)) < \infty$. The case of triangles, that is, $r=3$, has been studied in recent years.
